title: Direct authenticated network protocols are not bound to their advertised stratum
description: Correctness review: direct NTS/Roughtime/authenticated-SNTP samples validate only that SourceClass.NETWORK is allowed for the chosen stratum. An NTS-authenticated sample can claim MESH_DERIVED, for example. Enforce an explicit protocol-to-stratum policy (NTS to NTS, Roughtime to ROUGHTIME, authenticated SNTP as specified) and add mismatch tests.
